authorization: 同意，继续阶段三。先用现有数据查清上涨缺口来自入场信号、环境筛选还是退出过早，再做针对性对照。保持费用、执行约定和年度目标不变，你自主推进，我看结果。
scope: S014 600722.SH; existing pinned 2019 execution warmup plus 2020-01-01..2026-10-15 development data only; no new upstream calls; announcements remain paused
frozen_contract: Initial cash 100000; fee 0.001 per side; HFQ_RESEARCH; prior-close +1% limit buy; existing market-sell open/lower-limit+1 tick; whole planned quantity; full available cash/100-share lots; fixed LimitBuyHold; no annual resets or terminal forced liquidation
annual_targets: Each year: strategy >=1.5*BuyHold if BuyHold positive else strategy>0; annual drawdown magnitude strictly below BuyHold. 2026 through Oct15 included without annualization. 60*CLOSED/1642>=3.
diagnosis: On each completely flat day in high_H3, classify using previous signal-day information: unready, no parent, environment rejection, reset, execution failure. Classes must be exhaustive and exclusive. Decompose positive and negative benchmark log returns, not positive days alone.
Within no-parent days, distinguish missing negative opening gap from missing positive intraday candle and both. These are descriptive unfilled opportunity sets, not attainable alpha.

Assess exactly three extra trading days after actual exits as a separate overlapping diagnostic dimension. Include negative outcomes, all seven years, and excluding 2026. It cannot be added to the flat-day categories or treated as a tradable strategy.
conditional_comparison_proposal: After reading attribution, lock a minimal fixed factorial if supported: entry parent vs up-candle (remove only negative-gap requirement), environment high vs all (all still require original readiness), H3 vs H6 (exactly three added sessions). Reuse original parent/all/H3 and parent/high/H3 authenticated accounts; six new complete accounts. Stop or revise proposal before account execution if attribution contradicts it, documenting reason.
selection_limits: No new independent holdout: all dates already seen. Whole-period or per-year results must not create retrospective annual switches. Factorial identifies effects within these specified constructions, not universal causal effects or unique shares of missed market profits.
publication: Public batch evaluation and evidence, preserve all valid negative results, independent daily ledger audit; final handoff contains prior frontier plus any new passing/frontier candidates. No automatic stage four or production.
